b2_hybrid_receipt_problem_branch.issue: stdout_bytes = receipt.stdout_text.encode('utf-8') round-trips raw subprocess bytes through decode(replace) then re-encode. The persisted file is the round-tripped bytes, not the raw subprocess output. Authority chain is hybrid (CommandResult identity + decode/re-encode observation metadata).
b2_hybrid_receipt_problem_branch.fix_path: Pass artifact_dir=log_dir to run_controlled so the runner itself writes raw subprocess bytes to disk and computes SHA/size from the persisted file. RedObservation binds stdout_ref / stdout_sha256 / stdout_size_bytes from receipt fields directly with no recomputation.
